title: Pro Football: 2026-27 Best Regular Season Record
description:
This market will resolve according to the team that finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season with the best regular season record (the highest winning percentage among all 32 teams).

If at any point it becomes impossible for the listed team to finish the 2026-27 NFL regular season with the best regular season record, the corresponding market will resolve to "No".

If two or more teams finish tied for the best regular season record, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team with the greater regular season point differential (points scored minus points allowed). If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team with more regular season points scored. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team whose listed name comes first alphabetically.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed after January 24, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the final regular season standings have not been officially determined within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL (https://www.nfl.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: Fantasy Football: 2026-27 Top 5 Scoring RBs
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the named running back finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) ranked among the top 5 running backs by total fantasy points under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports. Otherwise, that market will resolve to "No".

Only regular-season games count; postseason (playoff) games are excluded. If two or more running backs are tied such that more than 5 would qualify for the top 5, the tie will be broken by higher fantasy points per game average for the 2026 NFL regular season, and if a tie still persists, by last name in alphabetical order, so that exactly 5 running backs are classified as top 5.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the rankings cannot be determined within this timeframe, all markets in this event will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be official season-total statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

This market will resolve to "Yes" if any player records more than 1,964 receiving yards during the 2026-27 NFL regular season, thereby breaking the NFL single-season receiving yards record. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".
